question: Convert to active: The forms will be verified by the board within an hour.

options.text: The board verifies the forms within an hour.
The board will verify the forms within an hour.
The forms verified by the board soon.
The board had verified the forms in an hour.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The forms will be verified by the board within an hour."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the board" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "will be verified" to "will verify" (future simple active).
 
• Ensure the time phrase "within an hour" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The board will verify the forms within an hour."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The board verifies the forms within an hour." – Incorrect tense (present simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"The forms verified by the board soon." – Grammatically incorrect sentence structure.
 
• **Option 4: **"The board had verified the forms in an hour." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
